children: Range drew $60,000 on a sponsor-issued $540,000 unsecured promissory note, leaving $240,000 outstanding.
Company issued an unsecured promissory note up to $540,000 to its sponsor to fund monthly trust contributions.
$60,000 was drawn on Sept 22, 2026 and deposited into the IPO trust account, with $240,000 now outstanding.
Note bears no interest and is payable on consummation of a business combination or upon winding up; repayment from trust funds is limited.
Note includes customary default provisions and was issued under Section 4(a)(2) exemption from registration.
